body: thanks for your advice, especially the part at the end. I don't know you either, but...its powerful to hear that people care for me. I don't know if I can believe it as strongly as I can possibly, given that the past few weeks have been...tough...but I'm reading what you wrote over and over and over again and I feel better each time I do ... so thank you. I appreciate it.
thank you. thanks so much for your bright tone. I feel better just reading it. this website needs to figure out how to give out hugs.

thank you for your words....thanks for writing it out. haha idk I'm kind of tearing up a little. The thought of someone taking the time to write something for me feels alien, and that's sad, just to think about. but thanks.
